replacements.OCRBench v2: \"leer\" un documento ≠ \"r: OCRBench v2: "reading" a document ≠ "reasoning over" it
replacements.Los modelos que leen texto limpio con al: Models that read clean text accurately still struggle with real document layouts. OCRBench v2 measures the gap between those two regimes.
replacements.Fuente estándar · orientación horizontal: Standard font · horizontal orientation · no complex structure
replacements.Texto extraído con alta fidelidad. Error: Text extracted with high fidelity. Occasional minor transcription errors on uncommon characters.
replacements.Leer números y fechas en formato estánda: Read numbers and dates in standard formats
replacements.Identificar títulos y secciones con form: Identify titles and sections with clear formatting
replacements.El texto en orientación horizontal con f: Horizontally oriented text in standard fonts is well represented in model pretraining data. The model can apply pattern recognition directly without needing to reason over structure.
replacements.Layout complejo: estructura que rompe el: Complex layout: structure that breaks linear parsing
replacements.Celdas fusionadas · texto rotado · fórmu: Merged cells · rotated text · formula embedded in the flow
replacements.Confusión en la asignación de valores a: Values are often assigned to the wrong columns when cells are merged. Rotated text may be ignored or mistranscribed. Formulas can be detached from the data flow they belong to.
replacements.Asignar valores a filas en tablas con ce: Assign values to rows in tables with merged cells
replacements.Extraer fórmulas integradas en texto nar: Extract formulas embedded in narrative text
replacements.El modelo procesa el documento como secu: The model processes the document as a text sequence rather than as a structure with spatial relationships between cells. Merged cells, rotated text, and formulas require treating layout as semantic structure, not merely extracting character strings.

replacements.La brecha que reveló OCRBench v2: The gap revealed by OCRBench v2
replacements.La diferencia entre \"leer\" y \"razonar: The gap between "reading" and "reasoning over" a document remains substantial. A model may extract text accurately and still fail on questions that require combining information from different regions, because that requires maintaining logical coherence across the document structure rather than merely recognizing characters.
